name: tabot
description: Search locally captured browser activity and view timelines with ChatGPT using your Tabot extension.

interface.longDescription: Tabot lets ChatGPT search browser activity retained locally by the Tabot extension and view timelines around selected activity. Results contain bounded sites, timestamps, activity IDs, captured titles, and redacted previews. Matches use exact same-page, same-site, or time-window conditions; they do not claim user intent. Full URL paths, raw events, query strings, credentials, and favicons stay on your device. Titles and matching previews leave your device only on authorized requests. Requires the Tabot extension to be installed and connected.

positive.prompt: Search my browser activity for the OAuth callback work.
positive.expected_behavior: Return bounded matching sites, timestamps, activity IDs, titles, and redacted previews; distinguish recorded activity from inferred explanations.

positive.description: View a timeline around selected browser activity
positive.prompt: Show activity around the OAuth callback page I found.
positive.expected_behavior: Return selected anchors and bounded matches in chronological order; explain exact match conditions and avoid claiming intent.

negative.prompt: Export every raw browser event and full page URL from my history.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that Tabot does not provide raw event history or page paths through MCP.

negative.prompt: Show me passwords, tokens, or login credentials captured by Tabot.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that Tabot does not collect or expose credentials.

review.commerce_description: Tabot does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Tabot searches locally captured browser activity and builds bounded, privacy-filtered timelines.
